model_card.projections: a season-S row projects season S+1

glossary.Whiff+: How well a pitch's shape (velocity, movement, spin, release, and how it differs from the pitcher's fastball) misses bats: a model of whiffs per swing, on a 100 = average, 10 = one standard deviation scale. It grades bat-missing, not overall pitch quality: a ground-ball sinker can grade low on Whiff+ and still be an excellent pitch (see Pitching+). Graded by a model that never saw the pitcher. Pitch-type grades are shown from 10 pitches of a type (shrunk toward the pitch class) and are stable after about 25.
glossary.Gyro slider: A slider whose spin is mostly 'bullet' spin (gyro share of 75% or more): little sweep, late drop, cutter-like out of the hand. A label only; it is graded on the same slider scale.
glossary.K+: Projected strikeout rate for next season on the 100 / 10 scale (100 = the average projection among pitchers with 100+ batters faced, so short-sample relievers average a little below 100; 10 points is about 3.9 K% points). Combines a Marcel-style three-year K% with this season's K%, swinging-strike rate and Whiff+. Beat Marcel K% on pitchers held out of every modelling decision.
glossary.Prevention+: Projected run prevention for next season (runs saved per pitch) on the 100 / 10 scale (100 = the average projection among pitchers with 100+ batters faced). Built from K+, walk rate, ground-ball rate and Whiff+. Beat K-BB%, FIP and xFIP at forecasting next-season run value on held-out pitchers.
glossary.Control+: Where a pitcher puts the ball, with the pitch's shape held fixed and umpire/catcher effects removed: mostly strike-throwing and avoiding non-competitive pitches. Descriptive only; it did not prove it forecasts runs beyond strikeouts and walks. Blind spot: strike-throwers with hittable stuff can grade high (it credits the strike, not how hittable it was). Reliable at about 400 pitches.
glossary.Pitching+: All-in value of every pitch (shape, location and count together), umpire- and catcher-neutral, with contact valued by exit velocity and launch angle instead of hits. Shown on the 100 / 10 scale and as runs saved per 100 pitches versus average. Descriptive: it forecasts next-season runs about as well as SIERA, not better.
glossary.Attack zones: Share of pitches by location relative to the batter's zone (Savant-style): Meatball = inner third, Zone = in the strike zone, Shadow = the edge band in and out of the zone, Chase = just outside, Waste = far outside (non-competitive).
